def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 100
    annual_coupon_rate = 0.10
    spot_rates = [0.08, 0.09, 0.095]
    annual_coupon_payment = face_value * annual_coupon_rate

    # Discount each cash flow using its corresponding spot rate
    cash_flows = [
        annual_coupon_payment,
        annual_coupon_payment,
        annual_coupon_payment + face_value,
    ]
    bond_value = sum(
        cash_flow / (1 + spot_rate) ** year
        for year, (cash_flow, spot_rate) in enumerate(
            zip(cash_flows, spot_rates), start=1
        )
    )
    answer = round(bond_value, 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
